title: Visual
purpose: Does the page look right at every width and theme the org supports, from a 360 px phone to a 3840 px TV read from ten feet? The vision inspector (PAP-84) applies these items to Gate 3 screenshots and DOM metrics; Justin uses them when he glances at the digest.
scope: Screenshots and DOM metrics at 360, 390, 768, 1280, 1920, 2560 and 3840 px in every theme; Storybook stories; contact sheets (PAP-248).
notCovered: Semantics, names and keyboard behaviour (accessibility rubric), even when the symptom is visible.
Whether the layout matches the spec's declared components (spec-conformance rubric).
Brand taste and copy tone: file as `question` or `praise`, not a defect.

S0: A modal renders behind the page at 360 px so the only way to dismiss it is hidden: the user is locked out of the flow (access to the product is blocked).
S1: Horizontal overflow at 360 or 390 px (`scrollWidth > clientWidth`).
A status badge in dark theme at 2.1:1 contrast.
S2: A 5 px misalignment between a label column and its inputs.
Theme leak: a hard-coded `#fff` background in dark theme on a secondary panel.
S3: Intentional truncation of a long name with a tooltip present.

items.title: Horizontal overflow
items.test: Can I find a width in the seven-width matrix where the page or a container scrolls horizontally or content escapes the viewport?
items.verify: `reports/dom-metrics.json` `scrollWidth > clientWidth` per screenshot (confidence 0.9 when DOM-confirmed); the screenshot shows cut content; cite the width and theme.
items.falsePositives: Intentional horizontally scrolling regions (carousels, wide tables in a scroll container) with visible affordance.

items.title: Clipping and overlap
items.test: Can I find text or controls clipped by `overflow: hidden`, covered by a sticky header, a toast or another element, or drawn outside their card?
items.verify: Elements outside viewport or overlapping in DOM metrics; bounding box in the screenshot; reproduce at the cited width.
items.falsePositives: Decorative bleeds and intentional stacking (avatars) with no lost information.

items.title: Truncation without a tooltip
items.test: Can I find text ending in an ellipsis whose full value is not available on hover, focus or tap (no `title`, tooltip or expand)?
items.verify: DOM metrics list `text-overflow: ellipsis` hits with `title` presence; truncation with a tooltip is intentional and downgrades to S3; truncation of a primary value (amount, name in a row header) with no tooltip is S1.
items.falsePositives: Truncated secondary text with a details view one click away.

items.title: Misalignment
items.test: Can I find elements in one visual row or column whose edges differ by 4 px or more where the design system aligns them (labels to inputs, icons to text baselines, card edges)?
items.verify: Measure bounding boxes in the screenshot or DOM metrics; cite the two elements and the offset.
items.falsePositives: Offsets under 4 px; intentional optical alignment in icon glyphs.

items.title: Contrast
items.test: Can I find text under 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text and UI components) against its actual background in any theme?
items.verify: Sample the bbox with `sharp` and compute the ratio (PAP-84); below 3:1 keeps the severity, otherwise downgrade to `question`; state the ratio and theme.
items.falsePositives: Disabled controls (still S3 if illegible); decorative text.

items.title: Spacing and rhythm
items.test: Can I find spacing that is not a design token step, uneven gaps between siblings, or padding that collapses at a narrow width?
items.verify: Compare computed margins and paddings with the `packages/tokens` scale; cite the element and the values.
items.falsePositives: One-off spacing documented in the component's story.

items.title: Target size
items.test: Can I find an interactive element whose hit area is under 44 by 44 px, or two targets closer than 8 px, at any width or input mode?
items.verify: Bounding boxes of `button`, `a`, inputs and custom controls in DOM metrics; cite the element, its size and the width.
items.falsePositives: Inline text links inside a paragraph (WCAG exception) that also have an equivalent 44 px control nearby.

items.title: Theme leaks
items.test: Can I switch theme and find a hard-coded colour, a light image on a dark surface, an unstyled native control or a focus ring that vanishes?
items.verify: Compare the same screenshot across themes; grep the diff for literal colours outside `packages/tokens`.
items.falsePositives: Brand marks that are intentionally theme-invariant.

items.title: Responsive matrix and 10-foot legibility
items.test: Can I find a width where the layout does not adapt (phone layout stretched to 3840 px, desktop layout squeezed to 360 px), or text under 16 px at 1920 px and above that a viewer three metres away cannot read?
items.verify: Contact sheet across the seven widths; type scale at 1920, 2560 and 3840 uses the large-screen tokens; primary actions remain visible without scrolling on TV widths.
items.falsePositives: Dense data tables that intentionally keep a fixed density with a zoom control.

items.title: Images, icons and media
items.test: Can I find a stretched or blurry image, a missing icon, a media element without a poster or size, or layout shift when it loads?
items.verify: Compare intrinsic and rendered sizes in DOM metrics; check `width`/`height` attributes; watch the video replay for shift (PAP-83).
items.falsePositives: Placeholders in dev mode that are labelled as such.
